svg.title: AI-driven development and certifications
svg.desc: A spinning wireframe torus stands for the AI-in-the-loop workflow: Claude Code, MCP and Copilot, connected to codebase, tools and data. He also built a fully local RAG stack (LangChain, Ollama, ChromaDB) and Tesseract OCR services. Certifications: Anthropic Claude Code in Action, Introduction to Model Context Protocol, Claude 101 (all Aug 2026); Microsoft AZ-204 Azure Developer Associate, AI-900, AZ-900.
